weather.blurb: About as nice as Austin gets. Get outside.

air.blurb: Fine for most of us. If your lungs are touchy, take it a little easy.

lake.blurb: The lake is close to full — good for boats and for the summer water supply. Down a touch from last week.

pollen.note: Tree 3 · Grass 2 · Weed 4 · Ragweed, Elm, Grasses
pollen.blurb: Ragweed and elm and grasses are heavy today. Windows closed, meds early.

grid.blurb: Demand peaks near 59,500 megawatts; ERCOT has 87,100 ready and room to spare.

sun.blurb: The sun is up for 11 hours and 18 minutes today, and down by 6:54 p.m.
